pairs.subject: agent-runtime-assembly
pairs.evidence: src-tauri/core/src/models/build_session.rs:11 The build-session status vocabulary has no indeterminate or interrupted status, so a build the app restarted under is closed as `failed`, with `interrupted_by_restart` written only into a message string (db repo recover_orphans, build_sessions.rs:577). That is exactly the closure the technique forbids.

techniques.evidence: src-tauri/core/src/models/build_session.rs:18 Restart orphans that cannot be resumed are written `phase = 'failed'`, and the interruption is encoded in error_message text through INTERRUPTED_BY_RESTART. The rule is 'when the vocabulary has no such status, add one; do not encode it in a message string'. The resume branch does count restarts and checks the cap before the freshness window, which conforms.
